cases.case_label: 184-bp AluJ-derived insertion in exon 6 of MSH2
cases.mechanism_detail: A 184-bp AluJ-like insertion in MSH2 exon 6 segregates with HNPCC; the authors argue it arose by Alu-mediated recombination rather than retrotransposition (no retrotransposition hallmarks), so it may not be a true MEI.
cases.quote: The Alu J insertion was most likely derived from Alu-mediated recombination, since Alu J elements have been found close to the insertion site in adjacent introns, and since elements pivotal for Alu retrotransposition are missing.
